Title: Core Functional Test - Object Detection and Gripper Activation for SODA/WATER
Description: Validates the robot's ability to detect object types (SODA or WATER) using distance sensors D1 and D2, activate gripper for grasping, and perform state transitions from INIT to BAND, MOVING, and HOME after placing the object.
Objective: Ensure accurate object type detection and gripper activation with proper state transitions
Comments: Enforces safety constraints RQ1–RQ5 during operation

Title: Boundary Value Analysis - Object Distance Detection at Threshold Limits
Description: Tests the system's behavior when object distances are exactly at the lower and upper boundary values for SODA/WATER detection using D1 and D2 sensors.
Objective: Validate system response at boundary conditions of object distance thresholds
Comments: Includes testing at minimum and maximum detectable ranges

Title: Error Recovery Test - Invalid Object Type Detection
Description: Simulates detection of an unknown or invalid object type and verifies the system's error recovery mechanism, including error logging and safe state transition.
Objective: Ensure system handles invalid object types gracefully with appropriate error recovery
Comments: Checks for proper handling of unexpected inputs during detection phase

Title: User Input Validation - Gripper Control Commands
Description: Validates the system's ability to process valid and invalid gripper control commands (open, close, release) with appropriate feedback and error handling.
Objective: Ensure correct interpretation and execution of user inputs for gripper operations
Comments: Includes edge cases such as repeated commands and timing issues

Title: Positive Test - Successful SODA Object Detection and Placement
Description: Verifies successful detection of a SODA object, activation of gripper, movement to designated bin, and proper state transition sequence.
Objective: Confirm correct operation for valid SODA item handling
Comments: Tests full workflow from INIT to HOME

Title: Positive Test - Successful WATER Object Detection and Placement
Description: Verifies successful detection of a WATER object, activation of gripper, movement to designated bin, and proper state transition sequence.
Objective: Confirm correct operation for valid WATER item handling
Comments: Tests full workflow from INIT to HOME

Title: Negative Test - No Object Detected Within Range
Description: Simulates no object present within sensor detection range and verifies system behavior including error reporting and safe state handling.
Objective: Ensure system correctly handles absence of detectable objects
Comments: Checks for appropriate timeout or idle behavior

Title: Negative Test - Sensor Malfunction During Object Detection
Description: Simulates sensor failure during object detection and validates system's error handling and safety protocols.
Objective: Validate system response to hardware or sensor failures
Comments: Ensures RQ1–RQ5 are enforced even under fault conditions

Title: Core Functional Test: Safe Movement Between Locations
Description: Verify that the robot moves safely between predefined locations (BANDi, HOMEi, REDi, WHITEi) following required safety constraints RQ1–RQ5 and transitioning through appropriate states (BAND, MOVING, HOME, RED, WHITE).
Objective: Validate correct path planning and state transitions during safe movement between defined locations.
Comments: Ensure all safety constraints are enforced during navigation.

Title: Boundary Value Analysis: Movement Time Constraints at Lower and Upper Boundaries
Description: Test movement times at the lower and upper boundaries of time-sensitive constraints to ensure system behavior remains within acceptable limits for safe navigation.
Objective: Validate system response when movement times approach boundary values.
Comments: Check adherence to time-sensitive movement requirements at critical thresholds.

Title: Error Recovery Functional Test: Obstacle Detection During Movement
Description: Simulate an obstacle appearing mid-movement to test the robot's ability to detect and respond appropriately, including stopping or rerouting while maintaining safety constraints.
Objective: Ensure error recovery mechanisms activate correctly upon encountering unexpected obstacles.
Comments: Validate system behavior under interruption scenarios.

Title: User Input Validation Test: Invalid Location Selection
Description: Test the system's handling of invalid location inputs such as non-existent or out-of-range locations during movement initiation.
Objective: Validate error handling for invalid user input in location selection.
Comments: Ensure appropriate feedback is provided for incorrect location entries.

Title: Negative Test: Collision at Intermediate Location
Description: Introduce a simulated collision at an intermediate location (e.g., between HOMEi and REDi) to verify that the system halts safely and does not violate safety constraints.
Objective: Validate system behavior when a collision occurs during movement.
Comments: Ensure no unsafe state is entered due to collision.

Title: Edge Case Test: Movement Between Adjacent Locations
Description: Test movement between adjacent locations like BANDi to HOMEi, ensuring minimal delay and proper state transitions without unnecessary stops or re-routes.
Objective: Validate efficient movement for short-distance paths.
Comments: Check performance and correctness of nearby location navigation.

Title: State Transition Verification: BAND to MOVING to HOME
Description: Verify that the robot correctly transitions through states (BAND → MOVING → HOME) when moving from BANDi to HOMEi, adhering to safety constraints.
Objective: Ensure proper state management during movement sequence.
Comments: Confirm correct order and timing of state changes.

Title: Core Functional Test - Correct Object Classification and Gripper Operation
Description: Verify that the system correctly identifies objects (SODA/WATER) and performs gripper operation as expected when object classification is accurate.
Objective: Validate core functionality of object detection and gripper behavior under correct classification
Comments: Ensure gripper operates without error for valid object types

Title: Boundary Value Analysis - Object Classification Threshold Test
Description: Test system behavior at boundary values of object classification confidence thresholds to ensure proper handling of near-threshold classifications.
Objective: Validate system response when classification confidence is at or near threshold limits
Comments: Check for consistent behavior at lower and upper boundaries of classification confidence

Title: User Input Validation - Invalid Object Type Handling
Description: Test how the system handles invalid or unexpected object types during classification, ensuring appropriate error messages and graceful degradation.
Objective: Validate input validation for object type recognition
Comments: Ensure system does not crash or enter unsafe states with invalid inputs

Title: Negative Test - Gripper Attempt on Misidentified Item
Description: Test gripper behavior when attempting to grasp an item that was misclassified, verifying error handling and safety protocols.
Objective: Ensure safe operation of gripper during incorrect object grasp attempts
Comments: Monitor for any mechanical or operational anomalies during failed grasp

Title: Positive Test - Successful Re-attempt After Misclassification
Description: Validate that the system successfully re-attempts object detection and grasp after a previous misclassification.
Objective: Confirm successful recovery from classification errors
Comments: Ensure no loss of functionality or state corruption during retry

Title: Error Recovery Test - Alert Triggering for Classification Errors
Description: Verify that the system correctly triggers alerts when misclassification occurs and logs the error appropriately.
Objective: Validate alert mechanism for incorrect object classification
Comments: Ensure alert is visible and logged in system logs

Title: Edge Case Test - Ambiguous Object Classification
Description: Test system behavior when presented with ambiguous or partially visible objects that could be misclassified.
Objective: Validate handling of edge-case object classification scenarios
Comments: Ensure consistent and safe operation under uncertain conditions

Title: Core Functional Test: Place Object in Correct Bin with State Validation
Description: Verify that the robot correctly places a grasped object into the appropriate bin (REDi or WHITEi) based on object type, and transitions through defined states (INIT, BAND, MOVING, HOME, RED, WHITE). Ensure gripper releases object only after confirming correct placement.
Objective: Validate accurate object placement in designated bins with proper state transitions
Comments: Test covers successful execution of object placement sequence

Title: Verify Safety Constraints During Recovery
Description: During error recovery, ensure that all safety constraints remain enforced and no unsafe actions are performed.
Objective: Validate safety compliance during system recovery
Comments: Monitor for emergency stops or shutdowns if required

Title: Verify Collision Avoidance with Obstacle Detection During Movement
Description: Validate that the robot detects an obstacle in its path using sensors and halts or reroutes to avoid collision, ensuring compliance with RQ1–RQ5. The gripper must remain in a safe state (open or closed) depending on current task status.
Objective: Ensure robust collision avoidance mechanism during dynamic movement
Comments: Test includes verification of sensor data processing and robot response
